## Module Boundaries (ADR-008)

- [ ] CHK001 `:core` depends only on `:proto` — verify with `./gradlew :core:verifyModuleBoundary`
- [ ] CHK002 No `java.*` or `android.*` imports in `commonMain` source sets
- [ ] CHK003 No `kotlin.Result<T>` in public API
- [ ] CHK004 No `Mutex`/`atomicfu`/`synchronized` in engine paths (actor is the synchronization primitive)
- [ ] CHK005 Transport-side locks carry `// ADR-012:` annotation if present

## ABI & Public API

- [ ] CHK006 Every new public symbol has a KDoc comment (Dokka CI gate)
- [ ] CHK007 `./gradlew checkKotlinAbi` passes — no unintended public API drift
- [ ] CHK008 If public API intentionally changed: `./gradlew updateKotlinAbi` run and `api/*.api` committed
- [ ] CHK009 No `public` visibility leaked onto internal types
- [ ] CHK010 API shape follows ADR-005 conventions

## Protocol Fidelity

- [ ] CHK011 Wire behavior matches `meshtastic/firmware` (cite source files/lines)
- [ ] CHK012 Proto types come from vendored submodule only — no manual proto edits
- [ ] CHK013 `docs/protocol.md` updated if wire-level behavior changed
- [ ] CHK014 `docs/manual-tests.md` entry added if transport-level changes need device verification

## KMP Target Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 All affected modules compile for: `jvm`, `androidTarget`, `iosArm64`, `iosX64`, `iosSimulatorArm64`
- [ ] CHK016 Platform-specific code uses `expect/actual` — not conditional compilation
- [ ] CHK017 `Dispatchers.IO` not used from `commonMain` (use per-platform `expect/actual` dispatchers)
- [ ] CHK018 Byte payloads use `kotlinx.io.bytestring.ByteString`, not `okio.ByteString`

## Testing

- [ ] CHK019 Tests written in `commonTest` BEFORE implementation (Principle III)
- [ ] CHK020 Tests use `:testing` module fakes (`FakeRadioTransport`, `InMemoryStorage`, `TestClock`)
- [ ] CHK021 Flow tests use Turbine
- [ ] CHK022 `./gradlew jvmTest` passes
- [ ] CHK023 `./gradlew iosSimulatorArm64Test` passes (if on macOS)

## Code Quality

- [ ] CHK024 `./gradlew spotlessCheck` passes (ktlint formatting)
- [ ] CHK025 `./gradlew detekt` passes (static analysis)
- [ ] CHK026 License header present on new `.kt` files (Spotless enforced)
- [ ] CHK027 Max line length ≤ 120 characters
- [ ] CHK028 No wildcard imports (except in test files)

## Storage (if applicable)
